You're working in the Kodely app codebase at /root/kodely-dev (a Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Prisma + Postgres app — an AI website builder, "rocket.new alternative"). This is a plain directory, NOT a git repo, so just edit files directly.

Context on conventions already established in this codebase:
- lib/db.ts exports `db` (a PrismaClient singleton).
- lib/auth.ts exports `getCurrentUser()`, `requireUser()`, `createSession(userId)`.
- lib/credits.ts exports `grantCredits(userId, amount, reason)`, `getBalance(userId)`, `SIGNUP_GRANT`.
- prisma/schema.prisma has models: User, Session, Project (id, userId, name, slug, publishedAt), ProjectFile (projectId, path, content, published: boolean — draft rows have published=false), Message (projectId, role, content), Build, CreditLedger.
- app/api/auth/signup/route.ts is the signup endpoint: creates the User, grants SIGNUP_GRANT credits, creates a session, returns JSON.
- The site-builder agent (lib/agent.ts, function runAgent) writes files via write_file/delete_file tool calls during generation — its output format is: index.html required, optional additional .html/.css/.js files, all self-contained (no external requests, no build step, no CDN — content-security-policy blocks everything but 'self').

YOUR TASK: give new signups a seeded sample project instead of an empty dashboard, so the very first thing they see after signing up is a real, already-built site they can immediately edit — this is the "onboarding with a seeded sample project" item from the Kodely Phase 1 MVP scope.

1. Create lib/seed-project.ts exporting an async function `createSeedProject(userId: string)` that:
   - Creates a Project (name: "Example: Roan Coffee", a slugified slug).
   - Writes 2-3 ProjectFile rows (published: false, i.e. draft) forming a small but genuinely well-designed single-page site for a fictional coffee shop — index.html plus a styles.css. Follow the SAME hard constraints the AI builder itself follows (see lib/agent.ts's SYSTEM prompt for the full contract): no external requests of any kind, no CDN, system font stack only, inline SVG/CSS for any graphics, responsive down to 380px, semantic HTML, a prefers-color-scheme dark mode block, real specific copy (not lorem ipsum). Make it look genuinely designed — this is a new user's first impression of Kodely's design quality, so it must be good, not a placeholder. Take real care with layout, typography, and one distinctive visual idea (e.g. a nice hero, a menu section with real-looking items and prices, a location/hours section).
   - Also insert one Message row (role: "assistant", content: a short 1-2 sentence welcome explaining this is an example they can edit by describing changes in the chat).
   - Do NOT charge any credits for this — it's free onboarding content, not a generation the user paid for.
   - Return the created project id.

2. Wire it into app/api/auth/signup/route.ts: after granting SIGNUP_GRANT credits and before creating the session (or right after — your call), call `createSeedProject(user.id)`.

3. Also update app/dashboard/page.tsx if needed so the seeded project shows up naturally in the existing project list (it likely already will since it queries all projects for the user — just verify, don't rewrite the page unless something is actually broken).

Do NOT touch: lib/agent.ts, app/api/generate/route.ts, app/api/projects/[id]/publish/route.ts, or anything under app/admin — other engineers are working on those concurrently and touching them will cause conflicts.

When done, report back: the files you created/changed, and confirm you did not touch the excluded files.

--- schema.prisma ---
// Kodely — Phase 1 data model.
// Principles baked in here (see the Kodely board):
//  - every generation is a Build row with real token counts, so cost per build is never a guess
//  - credits are a ledger, never a mutable counter: the balance is derivable and auditable
//  - failed builds are recorded but NEVER charged

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  email        String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String?
  role         String   @default("CUSTOMER") // CUSTOMER | ADMIN
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  sessions Session[]
  projects Project[]
  ledger   CreditLedger[]
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
}

model Project {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  name      String
  slug      String   @unique // becomes <slug>.kodely.site when published
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  publishedAt DateTime?

  user     User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  files    ProjectFile[]
  messages Message[]
  builds   Build[]

  @@index([userId])
}

// The working tree of a generated project. `published` files are the live
// snapshot served on the public subdomain; draft files are what the preview shows.
model ProjectFile {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  projectId String
  path      String
  content   String
  published Boolean  @default(false)
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  project Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([projectId, path, published])
  @@index([projectId])
}

model Message {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  projectId String
  role      String // user | assistant
  content   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  project Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([projectId])
}

model Build {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  projectId String
  status    String    @default("RUNNING") // RUNNING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED
  model     String
  prompt    String
  error     String?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  endedAt   DateTime?

  inputTokens      Int @default(0)
  outputTokens     Int @default(0)
  cacheReadTokens  Int @default(0)
  cacheWriteTokens Int @default(0)
  filesWritten     Int @default(0)

  // Real model spend in micro-dollars, and what we actually charged.
  costMicros     Int @default(0)
  creditsCharged Int @default(0)

  project Project        @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  ledger  CreditLedger[]

  @@index([projectId])
}

model CreditLedger {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  delta       Int // negative = spend, positive = grant/refund
  reason      String
  buildId     String?
  balanceAfter Int
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  user  User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  build Build? @relation(fields: [buildId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId])
}
